instruction: The file `/home/user/Desktop/mystery.brd` is the board to process. Export its board netlist and save it as `/home/user/Desktop/mystery_netlist.txt`. Requirements: 1. `/home/user/Desktop/mystery_netlist.txt` must exist and be non-empty. 2. Every signal name from the board must appear somewhere in the netlist. 3. The netlist must include at least 70% of the board's `(element, pad)` pairs, written as `PART PAD` or `PART.PAD`. 4. For each signal, its name must appear near at least one of its contactref element names. [Software] On Linux, launch CadSoft EAGLE with `/opt/eagle-7.7.0/bin/eagle` (adjust to your install).
